analyst.summary: Chalet Hotels combines a premium hotel portfolio with a growing Bengaluru commercial real estate business. The very high year-on-year growth numbers in the data mostly reflect a low pandemic-era comparison base and new hotel capacity coming online, not a sustainable growth rate -- on a same-store basis, hotel occupancy and room revenue per available room actually declined this quarter, offset by higher room rates. The commercial real estate arm, though smaller, is genuinely growing fast at high margins. We rate this a Hold: a decent diversification story, but the headline growth figures overstate the underlying momentum.
